origin: Original procedural contact foley and filtered-noise wind. No samples, recordings, or melodies.

step_dry.layers: soft heel, loose gravel grains, short dusty sole scrape

step_metal.layers: rubber heel, damped steel panel resonances, short toe contact

step_water.layers: shallow splash, displaced water hiss, small decaying bubble modes

step_ice.layers: packed snow compression, irregular ice grains, soft sole contact

step_heavy.layers: damped mechanical foot weight, low panel flex, restrained gritty contact

wind.design: Five filtered-noise layers, periodic 1/2/3/5/7-cycle gust envelopes and restrained stereo width.
wind.loop: Full-period FFT noise and periodic modulation; no fade-out, seam crossfade, or silent gap.

generation: Deterministic PCM; Vorbis container serials may change between encodes.
review: Signal measurements and browser listening gallery; no listening assessment claimed.
